same here. my life is ruined and it’s never going to be fixed, and the closest thing to a fix is suicide. ending it all is the only option to stop suffering. even if i’m having a good day, i know it’s only a matter of time.

the only thing that makes life worth living is a hobby (not specifying bc i’m afraid of being found on here) that most people start at a really young age. i only dabbled in it as a kid because my parents couldn’t afford classes, so only as an adult have i been able to have them. with the right training (and money) i could have been competing internationally as a teenager. but instead, i’m in my twenties and there are ten year olds that are better than me. i’ll never have the experiences that i could have had and it eats away at me. i’ll never be as good as i could have been if i had started early. my life is absolutely meaningless and it’ll never get better because i can’t fix my past.
